prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Children's action-card ATLAS, exact 3 columns by 4 rows, twelve equal SQUARE cells, portrait 3:4 canvas. Regular strict grid edge-to-edge, no gaps, no printed borders, each illustration entirely inside its cell with generous cream-paper blank margin so cells can be cropped. Read row-major. Match reference warm watercolor colored-pencil children's book style, same preschool boy short dark brown hair, orange shirt, blue trousers. Simple wooden table, recognizable round chocolate-chip cookies on clean pale paper mat and blue-rim plate, blue pencil case, clear empty glass. NO text, numbers, arrows, labels, icons, watermarks. Each card ONE specific action, not multiple stages. Exact cell content:
Row1 left: boy displays two muddy open palms, cookies untouched on table. Row1 middle: close view boy washing BOTH hands with SOAP foam under flowing sink faucet, mud being washed off. Row1 right: boy's visibly CLEAN hand picks up ONE cookie from paper mat, away from mouth.
Row2 left: clean-handed boy holding cookie to open mouth, eating. Row2 middle: boy's CLEAN hands lift a completely EMPTY blue-rim plate, cookies still loose on paper mat. Row2 right: only several loose cookies on paper mat, NO plate NO hands.
Row3 left: boy lifts a completely EMPTY clear glass cup, loose cookies stay on mat. Row3 middle: boy lifts CLOSED BLUE PENCIL CASE, loose cookies stay on mat. Row3 right: boy picks up cookie with a clearly BROWN MUD-SMEARED hand, mouth far away, his other muddy hand visible; no washing.
Row4 left: boy eats cookie held to mouth in clearly BROWN MUD-SMEARED hand, both hands muddy, no washing. Row4 middle: boy lifts completely EMPTY plate with clearly BROWN MUD-SMEARED hands, cookies untouched on mat, no washing. Row4 right: entirely blank cream paper with absolutely no objects.
Maintain exact 3x4 equal square cell geometry. Keep boy and focal actions large and clear. Dirty hands very obvious brown patches; clean cards absolutely no brown stains. No checks/crosses or moral cues.

checks: initial situation does not complete intended next action
each card matches its manifest meaning
clean and muddy hands distinguished for snack
cropped action cards have no neighbouring-cell fragments
visualReview.limitations: Raster cell crop resized to 600x600; source cell is smaller than runtime dimensions.
